parameters.name: AgentKey
parameters.description: The key of the business space. If this parameter is not specified, the default business space is accessed. You can obtain the key on the business management page of the Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the dialog flow. The description can be up to 120 characters in length.

parameters.name: DialogName
parameters.description: The name of the dialog flow. The name can be up to 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the chatbot instance.
